title: SQL injection in test_set_admin_password
description: db.rs:119-122. The test_set_admin_password function uses format\!() to interpolate the Argon2 password hash directly into a raw_sql string: raw_sql(&format\!("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO admin ... VALUES (1, '{}', 0)", hash)). Argon2 hashes contain dollar signs and could theoretically contain single quotes in edge cases. While this is #[cfg(test)]-only code, it establishes a bad pattern that could be copied into production code. Should use parameterized queries (sqlx::query().bind()) instead.
